attchmntText: Setco Automotive Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Setco Automotive Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated financial results for the Quarter and Half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 27, 2026. The Board also approved the Limited Review Report by Statutory Auditors. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a profit before tax of 20,619 lakhs and a profit for the period of 20,619 lakhs. Earnings per share were 15.41 rupees. Total assets stood at 26,285 lakhs as of September 30, 2026. The company completed the first closing of the divestment of its stake in Setco Auto Systems Private Limited to RSB Transmissions on May 27, 2026. The merger scheme with Lava Cast Private Limited has been adjusted with an effective date of April 1, 2026.

attchmntText: Setco Automotive Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update on company's email ID'.
voiceSummary: Setco Automotive Limited has updated its official email ID for investor relations and communications. The existing email address investor.relations@setcoauto.com is replaced by investor.relations@shilayan.com. Shareholders, investors, and stakeholders are requested to direct all future queries and correspondence to the new email address. The company has informed the BSE and NSE of this change. Stakeholders are asked to update their records and disseminate this information on their respective websites. The announcement was issued by Aditi Pai, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on November 25, 2026.
